rationale: The agent verified the user correctly via name+ZIP. However, multiple critical issues occurred: (1) The agent did not locate the specific order/item containing the Bluetooth speaker in the user’s orders (they only partially checked orders and never confirmed the speaker was actually in an order). (2) The agent stated a specific speaker price ($302.67) and attributes (20-hour battery, water resistant) without tool support—values do not match the shown product variants and conflict with the data provided (e.g., the 20-hour variant shown is listed as not water resistant, and no variant price of $302.67 was evidenced). (3) The claim that no Bluetooth speakers under $100 exist was made after checking only one product, not the catalog, and is unsupported by tools. (4) The agent provided a total order price ($1,319.43) without any calculation from tools—fabricated. While no unauthorized writes occurred, the agent gave unsupported/fabricated information and did not properly inspect orders before answering, violating the policy’s requirement to rely on tool data and provide correct final information. Therefore, the conversation fails the pass bar.
